title: A coding agent's notes
blurb: A coding agent is told a repository's house rules once. The next day, with an empty context window, it is asked about invoicing and sign-in, names nobody used. It finds the billing and auth rules by meaning, and the graph adds what goes with them, such as where tests live.

try.text: How do I run the tests?
How are Kenji and pnpm connected?
Kenji is on leave until Friday
Is the auth owner around this week?

turns.user: A few house rules for this repo. We use pnpm, never npm. Tests live next to the code, as *.spec.ts files.

memories.text: Use pnpm in this repo, never npm
Tests live next to the code, as *.spec.ts files

turns.reply: Understood: pnpm only, and tests sit next to the code as *.spec.ts files.

turns.user: Run the tests with pnpm test. The auth module is Kenji's, so ask him before changing it.

memories.text: Run the tests with pnpm test
Kenji owns the auth module: ask him before changing it

turns.reply: Got it. pnpm test runs the tests, and I ask Kenji before touching auth.

turns.user: And don't touch the billing module. It's frozen until the audit is done.

memories.text: Do not change the billing module: it is frozen until the audit is done

turns.reply: Billing is off limits until the audit is done.
